pages.description: Princess Peach runs happily near a castle in this printable coloring page, bending both arms as one shoe steps forward beneath the lifted edge of her gown. A winding path of oval stones leads back to the castle's round towers, brick walls, and tall pointed central roof.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Playing Happily Near A Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach plays happily near a waterfall in this printable coloring page, raising one arm toward the falling water while balancing with her other arm extended. The stream drops between angular rock faces into a rippling pool beside flowers and shrubs, with a pointed sun overhead.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Relaxing Peacefully In A Fantasy Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach relaxes peacefully in a fantasy land in this printable coloring page, reclining on a long chair with closed eyes beneath an oversized flower-patterned parasol. Spotted mushrooms surround the chair and its small footstool, while a distant castle and spiral-ended clouds appear beyond the hills.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Smiling Happily In A Bright Adventure Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach smiles happily in a bright adventure land in this printable coloring page, standing with both arms stretched wide above the skirt of her gown. Rounded mountains with wavy bands rise behind small pointed trees and spotted mushrooms, beneath large clouds in an otherwise open sky.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Walking Carefully In A Magical World Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach walks carefully through a magical world in this printable coloring page, stepping along a winding stone path while holding the sides of her gown. Oversized spiral-spotted mushrooms, trees, flowers, and floating rocky islands surround the route toward a distant castle with pointed towers.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Posing Proudly In A Colorful World Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach poses proudly in a colorful world in this printable coloring page, resting both hands on her hips above the draped panels of her gown. Large spotted mushrooms rise behind a scalloped platform, with simple flowers, clouds, and small grass tufts around the full-length princess portrait.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Jumping With Joy In A Hidden Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach jumps with joy in a hidden cave in this printable coloring page, lifting both arms overhead and smiling with her eyes closed beneath her crown. Angular rock walls frame her gown, while crystal clusters, a falling stream, scattered stones, and an irregular pool fill the cavern.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Smiling Happily In A Snowy Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach smiles happily in a snowy level in this printable coloring page, holding her hands out beside her long gown as snow falls around her. Pointed evergreen trees line the rolling snowbanks behind her, with outlined snowflakes and round flakes surrounding her crown, curled hair, and puffed sleeves.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Getting Ready To Explore Near A Fortress Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach gets ready to explore near a fortress in this printable coloring page, carrying a compass and a coil of rope beside her long skirt. A backpack, bedroll, belt pouches, and boots complete her outfit, with vine-covered towers, an arched doorway, shrubs, and rocks behind her.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Jumping Happily In A Jungle Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach jumps happily in a jungle level in this printable coloring page, raising both arms while her gown lifts above the platforms beneath her feet. Palm-like leaves and hanging vines frame her crown, with spotted mushrooms, scalloped ledges, clouds, and a large circle in the sky.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Getting Ready To Explore In A Flower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach gets ready to explore a flower field in this printable coloring page, holding an open compass in one hand and a rolled map in the other. Her pocketed shirt, trousers, belt pouches, backpack straps, and boots stand among large blossoms, oversized spotted mushrooms, and distant hills.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Posing Happily On A Mountain Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach poses happily on a mountain level in this printable coloring page, waving one hand while the other rests at the waist of her gown. She stands on a rocky platform among raised ledges and jagged mountain outlines, with a small distant castle and a large sun overhead.

pages.title: Mario Princess Peach Running Happily In A Cloud World Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Peach runs happily through a cloud world in this printable coloring page, lifting one side of her gown while extending her other arm for balance. Her shoes peek below the sweeping skirt, surrounded by spiral-decorated clouds, outlined stars, and small hearts against the open sky.
